messages:
Hannah (People Ops): Quick Q from Diego: off-cycle promotion approved today. Need a short checklist and routing steps so managers don't miss the payroll cutoff.
Diego Morales (Manager): Thanks. What exactly do I need to attach and who approves market corrections vs merit? Also timeline for retro pay if we miss cutoff.
Priya (Comp & Rewards): Merit promos under manager budget: manager + People Ops approval. Market corrections or any change that crosses band/grade needs comp-ops review. For retros, comp-ops justification required.
Omar - Payroll: Payroll cutoff: US = EOD 2 business days before run; EMEA/APAC = vendor-specific (usually 4-7 business days). If you miss it, we process next cycle and schedule retro. Retro typically lands the following payroll cycle once paperwork is final.
Lena (Legal): If salary is in the contract, issue an amendment and get employee signature. Use the Legal amendment template in Confluence. Do not rely on verbal confirmations.
Hannah (People Ops): Minimal ticket checklist to paste: 
- Employee name + ID
- Manager name + approval date
- Change type (merit / market / promotion / temporary)
- New salary (annual) + new band
- Effective date (yyyy-mm-dd)
- Signed comp change form (attach)
- Contract amendment (if salary contractual)
- Retro justification (if applicable)
- Tags: comp-ops, payroll, legal (as needed)
Diego Morales (Manager): Perfect, filing HR-5012 now and tagging comp-ops and payroll. Thanks.
people-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff calendar is pinned in #people-ops/payschedule.
